extraction.Name: Benjamin Utterback
extraction.Recorded patent: The receipt for the patent was signed February 25, 1918, by the allottee. The patent was recorded July 10, 1918, by the Belvidere State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Benjamin Utterback and wife conveyed the land by deed to J. E. Utterback for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Allottee is deceased. Fee patent No. 612705 issued. Land described as Lot 1, section 1, Lot 1, section 2, and Southwest quarter of the Northwest quarter and Northeast quarter of the Southwest quarter, section 12, township 44, north of range 33. Conveyance dated March 30, 1918.
